scope: Conditional observer candidate refinement and actual DDS graph retry; full P2C.1 pending

four_original_snapshot_comparison.scope: Four original delivered chosen-assignment snapshots; conditional fixed-input comparison only, no original-history/causal mission or worst-case timing claim

actual_dds_graph_retry.scope: Controlled stale inventory after real node deletion; actual DDS/rclpy observer and retry, no Gazebo/Nav2 mission

config.purpose: Independent P2C.1 development and new source-frozen integration; accepted P3C.5 evidence remains historical.
rules: Commit and push all source/config/helper bytes before first task; no edits while any task owner/observer remains live.
Retain every original/failure/infrastructure interruption; no task retries or failed-cell backfill.
All ten fixed direct-ideal cells and forced2/protocol_forced2/holdout_ideal require native COMPLETE at unchanged300s/.35m/.05mps/.1radps/5s.
Delay/loss/holdout_fault outcomes are all retained; their safety and protocol gates require zero contacts/exhaustion/robot failures, not forced task success.
Each forced robot must charge; all actual charger_stopped return audits require positive energy and prediction error <=0 within1e-6.
No-route/empty-energy negative probes must fail correctly, never generate a straight-line Nav2 return; actual ROS synthetic-map failure is labelled component, not Gazebo motion.
Physical blackout probe reuses the predeclared60..250s staging stimulus and read-only native motion thresholds; both robots must independently return/charge.

101/202/303/707/809 are exposed;917/new geometry/target/fault29171 is first-exposure verification, not a held-out population estimate. First exposure only after development and full fixed/safety gates.
Budget envelope assumes bounded motion deviation, speed, reaction and recovery; no claim under infinite blockage, changing obstacles, broken executor or uncalibrated hardware.
opportunity_charge_rules: Successful real exploration first; never initial spawn top-up.
Only existing near-home range and visible body-safe contact route; serial request and handle drain retained.
At most three distinct useful current frontier alternatives; full known route and endpoint return; forecast is not a queued command.
Current map identity/source TTL and current delivered pose/TF/battery gates; next actual leg always revalidates.

native_pose_contract.frame_generation_stamp: native validity stamp minus actual SLAM transform_timeout; launch supplies the same configured offset as gateway
native_pose_contract.source_order: source stamps are preserved; valid sensor samples up to2s ahead of local /clock wait in one bounded128-entry heap; clock-matured duplicate/out-of-order sources are ignored, excessive-future samples never poison the current pose
native_pose_contract.unavailable: no finite budget/nav return or stable charging; bounded30s stop then explicit positive-energy failure
native_pose_contract.startup_recovery: Every charging entry, including immediate odom callbacks, resumes a funded initial missing-pose hold instead of charging; original low-energy/task charge requests remain valid.

native_energy_accounting.channel: read-only native battery_return_audit; not AP input or extra network traffic
native_energy_accounting.required: all regular originals; zero-energy negative has its independent no-navigation failure audit
native_energy_accounting.freeze_counterexample: native truth path>1m cannot have zero local distance/time accounting; retain all failures

return_source_selection.strategy: lowest qualified complete-contact energy budget; exact tie prefers local
sources: explicit conservative fused search with all fresh local occupied cell rectangles
return_source_selection.obstacle_veto: a fused route may extend local unknown space but may not clear local known obstacles; continuous half-local-cell checks preserve0.35m clearance and original bounded0.6m known-free start escape; no diagonal cutting
return_source_selection.ages: original5s source TTL for both maps; budget prices the maximum source age actually consulted, plus original2s pose leases
return_source_selection.evidence: all fresh map candidates/costs/qualification/selected minimum retained on read-only native return audit only; not AP input or added communication
return_source_selection.constrained_search: Only when the original fused shortest route fails the local-obstacle veto: project all local positive cells into a separate fused-grid search layer; keep unknown cells unknown, promote positive source cells to occupied, retain both originals, and still apply the original continuous local veto. No route remains unavailable.
return_source_selection.derived_provenance: Private native constrained_fused candidate: deterministic reconstruction from original local+fused grids; source_time=min(original stamps), version=max(original versions); age prices both originals. Never publish the derived grid as an application map.

rally_route_consistency.return_reservation: complete delivered-map contact-region route; same geometry cache and clearance as known_home_distance
rally_route_consistency.offsets: actual start to first grid point included in nominal approach, detour and parking costs
rally_route_consistency.unavailable: wait; charging reserves actual body; no local hidden inputs or centre-route fallback
rally_route_consistency.default_rally_route: infinite complete path was already in use; initial five-metre diagnosis withdrawn

ap_return_consistency.inputs: AP delivered fused planning map and per-robot maps only; current original map/pose/TF/battery leases remain
ap_return_consistency.admission: current and endpoint complete return must have a qualified local or locally-vetoed fused path; missing remains unavailable
ap_return_consistency.assignment: same qualified geometry for rally candidate return reserve and serial return reservations
ap_return_consistency.source_age: maximum consulted fresh map age is priced; no header renewal or native hidden input
ap_return_consistency.evidence: private coordinator_return_map_veto and optional own-map lookahead witnesses; not extra transmitted application load
ap_return_consistency.constrained_search: Same pure qualifier and explicitly labelled third route candidate; AP uses its delivered maps only, never the native original-map audit.

geometry_computation.obstacle_inflation: Euclidean distance transform <= unchanged integer clearance radius, with empty-obstacle special case; same original closed disk in every cell
geometry_computation.return_memo: Only immutable fused and local source grids; identical geometry/home/radius/position, source replacement or mutable alias invalidates; at most128 positions; returns independent result rows
geometry_computation.time_and_budget: Geometry only. Original sources, true evaluation epochs, source ages, native2/5s TTLs and every final dispatch lease check remain. No cached energy budget or timestamp renewal
geometry_computation.validation: Cell equality, qualification/route/budget equality, invalidation and actual ROS. Fixed snapshot timing is not a worst-case or mission result

return_tree_suffixes.algorithm: Exact shared reverse-predecessor route suffixes and contact-connected mask, reset with the existing content/geometry/home/radius field
return_tree_suffixes.safety: Every original continuous-check route vertex retained in identical order; no simplification, budget or timestamp cache

rally_level_reuse.algorithm: Invocation-only shared approach/home/qualified-return/clearance geometry for the original two candidate levels; never cache energy, charge waits, assignment or timestamps
rally_level_reuse.sources: Only bytes-owned immutable fused grid and every supplied local map; mutable grids and readonly views of mutable parents rebuild each level
rally_level_reuse.lifetime: One public assign_rally_poses call only; original positions/home/geometry fixed inside it, new proposal always gets a new cache
rally_level_reuse.computation_order: Prepare full energy options for the robot with fewer locally known raw endpoints first; local unknown/missing is only an ordering hint and never rejects a fused qualified path
rally_level_reuse.decisions: Original complete-return/body/observer/charge/wait/cap optimization and stable branch order; every final dispatch keeps original source TTL and budgets
rally_level_reuse.limits: Equal proposals and fixed-epoch CPU samples, not original timing/history, causal task benefit or a worst-case response guarantee

rally_return_repair.trigger: Idle ACTIVE unarrived non-observer; old endpoint has no qualified return, current pose retains one; all delivered source leases and target lease fresh; no live/pending exploration/rally/survey, charge or safety refuge.
rally_return_repair.search: Known-free target-visible grid centres in the existing nominal1..2.6m rally region, endpoint clearance0.45m and separation0.8m, body-masked complete approach and same qualified contact return. Dense recovery supplements original72 ring samples; no obstacle/unknown clearing.
rally_return_repair.budget: Complete approach+qualified endpoint return+reaction/map/max(odom,frame) age+hold/wait; strictly less than current energy. Next real dispatch revalidates all original leases/reservations/energy.
rally_return_repair.preservation: Only a new proposal; preserve parked peers, original retries/300s horizon/5s native hold/safety. Reset hold on actual assignment change; never cancel a live action or reset retries.
rally_return_repair.evidence: Private coordinator_rally_return_repair saves both delivered maps, original stamps, model, current/reserved/body positions, old/new endpoints and full route/cost; independent reconstruction. No native hidden input or added application traffic.

snapshot_consumption.subscriptions: AP delivered fused/robot map, odometry and map-frame TF use original reliable volatile keep-last1; discrete events/publishers/native safety queues unchanged
snapshot_consumption.source_time: Original source headers preserved; stale inputs still rejected by original5s/2s TTLs
snapshot_consumption.scope: Application latest-state coalescing after gateway delivery, not injected radio loss or application traffic change
snapshot_consumption.evidence: Actual DDS blocked-executor probe compares original10/20 queues with latest1 on50 unchanged source-stamped snapshots
snapshot_consumption.tf_reprojection: Each new delivered map-to-odom TF reprojects the last original odometry sample; its source timestamp and velocity remain unchanged, and original two independent2s leases still apply.

rally_return_objective.exposure: Soft weighted complete-return length between original0.35m path and0.45m endpoint margins; not energy, continuous clearance or dynamic-obstacle guarantee. Every existing hard constraint is unchanged.

rally_candidate_sampling.algorithm: original72 rings plus5/10degree outer-ring visible boundary refinement; inspect the existing angular tier if the first level is infeasible or requires its ACTIVE observer to charge
rally_candidate_sampling.region: unchanged known-free target-visible1..2.6m region,0.45m endpoint clearance and0.8m separation
rally_candidate_sampling.pricing: Each level retains original complete qualified return, observer/charge/wait/soft exposure/body cost optimization and cap feasibility; final fresh admission still required
rally_candidate_sampling.limits: At most the same two candidate tiers; retain the better complete original objective tuple, including a feasible first-tier fallback. A predicted funded observer only ranks geometry: current complete approach/return, wait/hold, original source-age and body admission remain mandatory. No new perception/truth input or causal/worst-case mission guarantee

native_snapshot_consumption.subscriptions: Native mixed TF retains20 with a separate lightweight input callback group; fused-map latest1; odometry remains original10, local map/task/charge/event/action queues unchanged
native_snapshot_consumption.scope: Two executor workers: only relevant TF ingress can run independently. All pose application, energy, budget, safety, charging and actions remain in the original mutually exclusive state group; no new AP observation or application traffic.
native_snapshot_consumption.coalescing: Filter original map-to-odom transforms before preserving the latest matured source and at most128 unique future stamps; a guard wakes the serialized consumer. Original native128-entry future heap/2s ahead window remains; overflow fails explicitly.
native_snapshot_consumption.meter: Odometry accounting code and queue depth unchanged; TF-only reprojection does not bill map-frame jumps. Required private5s energy ledger adds only a relevant TF receipt count.
native_snapshot_consumption.mixed_tf: Body transforms never overwrite a relevant snapshot or renew its lease. Original source offsets/2s pose/5s map TTLs remain, invalid future input cannot poison a later valid source.
native_snapshot_consumption.evidence: Actual two-worker DDS with the state group blocked and mixed relevant/body TF; blocked historical1/20 queues end with no relevant TF while the input mailbox retains original source50, with no concurrent state/energy/action mutation.

ap_pose_budget_contract.age: max(original delivered odometry source age, original delivered map-to-odom source age)
ap_pose_budget_contract.lookahead_evidence: both source ages retained privately and independently reconstructed

exploration_travel_preference.factor: min(1,(1+closest currently funded peer known distance)/(1+own known distance))
exploration_travel_preference.inputs: same delivered planning map/poses/frame/battery/own robot maps; pending charge and non-ACTIVE peers excluded
exploration_travel_preference.distance: known-free no-corner-cut route with original bounded escape and actual starting offset; complete actual body-masked path is priced again before admission
exploration_travel_preference.scope: Soft conditional utility preference; bounded continuation, fair serial charging, source TTLs and actual reservations remain; no global optimality or peer future-availability guarantee.
exploration_travel_preference.evidence: every executed regular frontier privately retains delivered map geometry, source leases, poses/models, nominal/actual distance, eligible peer budgets and utility factor; strict read-only reconstruction
exploration_travel_preference.map_evidence_scope: Only eligible ACTIVE/non-pending-charge own and peer return maps are consulted/saved; each has its original declared map source lease. Unconsulted charging peer maps are excluded.

config.physical_blackout_required: Both new originals at the formal commit; unchanged controlled60..250/62..248/.5m/1.1m stimulus. Full integration cannot PASS without their strict evidence. Execute only after all development and fixed/safety prerequisites.

exploration_frontier_commitment.trigger: Successful EXPLORE/FOUND_UNCONFIRMED short Nav2 prefix remains more than0.02m from full current viewpoint; retain that viewpoint as a scheduling preference.
exploration_frontier_commitment.admission: Regenerate current candidates; resume only within original1.2m and gain>max(200,20% prior gain), with current full body/reservation/energy/source checks and battery_factor1.
exploration_frontier_commitment.clear: Actual full viewpoint Nav2 success, native FAILED, ordinary navigation failure or no useful funded reachable current candidate clears preference; normal task/safety/retry limits remain.
exploration_frontier_commitment.evidence: Private executed witnesses retain current gain and optional prior intent; reconstruct gain from delivered map and verify current proximity/usefulness/funded energy. Not a new AP observation or application traffic.
exploration_frontier_commitment.limits: Bounded receding-horizon preference: currently useful continuation receives2x adjusted utility, not absolute priority. No stale command replay, global optimality or time guarantee.

native_filtered_tf.source: Existing robot-side sampler extracts only original map-to-odom transforms into /robot/battery/source_tf before the native DDS queue; no source stamp rewriting.
native_filtered_tf.native: All relevant transforms, duplicates, out-of-order and invalid futures reach the unchanged native consumer, which still owns original2s/5s/128/future deferral, ordering, energy and safety.
native_filtered_tf.gateway: Original /robot/gateway/source_tf monotonic filtering and packets unchanged; local sensor stream does not become an AP observation or modeled radio packet.
native_filtered_tf.queues: Native TF original reliable20/two-worker serialized-state-plus-input model, fused1/odom10 unchanged; native battery entire bytes unchanged from79f2113.
native_filtered_tf.proof: Actual DDS mixed reliability/body TF, source preservation/future/stale/energy checks; actual frozen graph binds each native stream only to its own battery manager.
native_filtered_tf.limits: Additional local DDS sensor forwarding, not Wi-Fi measurement; v19 graph lacked publisher QoS, so no retrospective QoS causal attribution.
native_filtered_tf.raw_input_queue: Robot-side mixed TF BestEffort buffer5 to100; filtering before original native20. Bounded buffering can change pre-network source availability, never original timestamps or gateway candidate throttles; every future baseline uses the same frozen source.

exploration_bounded_commitment.score: adjusted_utility*(2 if current useful funded continuation else1)
exploration_bounded_commitment.guards: Original full body-masked travel, accepted route reservations, complete round-trip energy, charging fairness and source leases remain hard admission checks.
exploration_bounded_commitment.evidence: Selected gain/group size/base utility/reuse exclusions/relative factor/continuation weight/score retained privately; strict reader reconstructs geometry and scores. Does not assert global maximum over unseen original history.
exploration_bounded_commitment.scope: One nominal-utility ranking change. Actual body-path energy is repriced before dispatch; nominal score is not an actual travel-time guarantee.

native_tf_graph_capture.scope: Read-only safety observer captures complete required application/native graph once all native battery topics are observed and all endpoint bindings exist; does not delay or change task clocks.
native_tf_graph_capture.evidence: native_graph.json kept alongside original early bypass graph, owner-bound optional observer command and reader source digests required. Missing evidence FAIL; old incomplete graphs are never repaired.

initial_known_space_search.scope: Complete object mission (enable_rally true) only; pure mapping and existing target reacquisition behavior stay unchanged.
initial_known_space_search.alternation: Successful full mapping viewpoint enables one known-space purpose; successful full known-space viewpoint returns to mapping. Short prefixes and safety charging preserve the current purpose; ordinary navigation failure returns to mapping.
initial_known_space_search.history: Position history remains for bounded local diversity. Directional known-space interest instead uses original delivered yaw/pose/frame records and current known-free sight; two-metre90degree predicted cones, not omnidirectional visit discs or target absence proof.
initial_known_space_search.view: Current known-free visible interest in a90-degree sector;16 deterministic headings. Occupied and unknown cells block sight; selected heading retained at the final Nav2 endpoint.
initial_known_space_search.admission: Original0.45m endpoint/0.35m known-free route, body masks, accepted reservations, current source TTLs, full approach+qualified contact return+reaction/wait reserve and charging fairness. Empty known-space candidate set falls back to ordinary mapping; unfunded candidates request original serial charging.
initial_known_space_search.inputs: Existing gateway delivered maps/poses/models only; no ground-truth target, hidden camera, native audit stream or new application packet.
initial_known_space_search.evidence: Private initial_visual_search witnesses retain delivered grids, positions, source leases, historical visit inputs, sector gain/yaw, full travel/energy and scheduling score; reader reconstructs them. Complete cohort must exercise at least one such witness.
initial_known_space_search.limits: Heuristic bounded current-map search preference, not exhaustive visual coverage, optimality, hardware safety or worst-case completion guarantee.

task_child_process_audit.during_task: Every nonzero ROS launch child exit before the owned SIGINT closure marker fails; outer owner exit0 cannot mask a child crash.
task_child_process_audit.cleanup: Actual post-task child exit codes retained separately; not task-time failures or evidence of graceful child exit.
task_child_process_audit.evidence: Original source-bound launch transcript required; no raw log repair.

mission_spatial_diversity.scope: Complete object missions with battery model only; ordinary mapping unchanged.
mission_spatial_diversity.anchor: Centroid of cached delivered static charger poses; missing/invalid metadata skipped, no model gives neutral preference. Not a new AP input or ground-truth target.
mission_spatial_diversity.history: Existing first fresh delivered position per0.5m bin; original odom/TF each0..2s at recording. Historical travel is a search preference, never camera coverage proof.
mission_spatial_diversity.algorithm: Outside original2m charger-centroid neutral region, count historical0.5m bins within2m of candidate with known-free line of sight in the current delivered planning grid; multiply nominal utility by max(0.25,1/sqrt(1+count)). Other rooms sharing a global direction are independent. Same bounded2x useful continuation and funded-nearer-peer preference remain.
mission_spatial_diversity.admission: Original current complete body-masked approach+qualified contact return, source TTLs, charging fairness and accepted route reservations unchanged. Soft positive factor never authorizes motion.
mission_spatial_diversity.evidence: Private executed witnesses preserve static model anchor, complete visit-source records, local visible visit indices, radius/neutral flag/factor and adjusted score beside current delivered grid; independent reader reconstructs. No added application packet.
mission_spatial_diversity.limits: Current-map local visibility is a search preference, not historical90degree camera coverage, optimality, peer future availability or worst-case native completion guarantee.

camera_aware_known_search.history: Original delivered pose and map-to-odom0..2s, first actual position/yaw per0.5m/22.5degree bin; no source rewriting or native input
camera_aware_known_search.view: Current delivered known-free rays within original2m/90degree sector; occupied and unknown cells occlude history. A travelled position no longer masks its unseen back side.
camera_aware_known_search.purpose: Alternating known-space search only; mapping, useful continuation, charging fairness, native energy and full known-free body/return admission unchanged
camera_aware_known_search.evidence: Every actual visual witness retains original heading/pose source records, fixed view model, delivered grids, chosen gain/yaw and original full budget for independent reconstruction
camera_aware_known_search.limits: Current-map predicted visual coverage is a search preference, never proof of target absence, perfect camera perception or exhaustive coverage; history reprojects through the current map only; no new radio packet

coordinator_live_clock.executor: Two workers; only the existing /clock subscription moves to an independent mutually exclusive group. Original state/action callbacks remain serialized.
coordinator_live_clock.clock_qos: Existing best-effort depth1 unchanged; no extra subscription or application message.
coordinator_live_clock.planning_lease: Capture original delivered source deadlines; abort current exploration batch at candidate/budget/route/dispatch checkpoints on expiry or clock reset. Recheck sources after charge/survey/rally computation before changing admitted owners.
coordinator_live_clock.budget_provenance: Distinct immutable source stamps, ranking/pricing instants and actual decision instant; age reconstructed at each instant, never renewed.
coordinator_live_clock.shutdown: Stop new admissions and cancel timers before waiting for executor completion.
coordinator_live_clock.limits: Clock correctness is independently DDS-verified with controlled blocked callback, not a CPU latency or native completion guarantee. No native battery, Nav2, physics, TTL, horizon or wireless change.
coordinator_live_clock.central_action_completion: Humble Future done callbacks are executor tasks outside callback groups. All8 central response/result registrations enqueue completed futures into one private SimpleQueue and trigger an existing-state-group guard; only its serialized drain mutates mission owners. Late completions after shutdown are ignored; context-active guard failures remain visible. No new DDS topic or application traffic.
coordinator_live_clock.native_action_completion: The same private callback serializer handles both native return response/result futures in the original native default state group; lightweight TF inbox remains independent, source stamps/heap/energy/return/charge equations and TTLs unchanged.

abandoned_input_diagnostics.channel: Existing private read-only coordinator audit, after irrevocable proposal abandonment
abandoned_input_diagnostics.inputs: Exact frozen callback geometry/source stamps/state/heading and visit history; source stamps never renewed
abandoned_input_diagnostics.limits: Diagnostic copies never enter the planner, protocol admission, native safety or navigation; no extra application network packet

config.evaluation_result_polling: Read-only bounded polling of a not-yet-valid JSON file from the same original producer; complete invalid objects, producer failure and original deadline still fail. No episode retry, evaluator change or shutdown grace change.

visibility_computation.rays: Original floating unrounded projections cached by radius only, max8 immutable tables; translation+rint occurs at actual grid cell exactly as before
visibility_computation.deduplication: Boolean flat hit mask replaces sort/unique; identical sorted cell set and count
visibility_computation.sectors: Original atan2(sin,cos) inclusive90degree/16yaw predicate precomputed for integer relative cells, max8 immutable radius/FOV tables; original tie order and yaw
visibility_computation.inputs: No map/history/source/age/energy budget cached here; current delivered occlusion and interest recomputed each call
visibility_computation.scope: Pure computation only; source TTL, true clock, native geometry/budget/300s/5s and all case/physical stimuli unchanged
visibility_computation.preparation: Generate original mapping frontiers only when that branch is needed; known-space search retains original mapping fallback and identical path-clearance travel fields

candidate_priority_computation.algorithm: lazy exact stable greedy with original raw utility and possible2x continuation as upper bounds
candidate_priority_computation.price: original complete return battery factor, relative geodesic factor and mission spatial diversity; only fully priced priority above all remaining bounds enters original body/route/full-budget checks
candidate_priority_computation.skip: unused options of already provisionally selected robot; original route loop skipped those same options; retain complete raw pool for existing charging lookahead
candidate_priority_computation.leases: true clock/source TTL checks at generation, each price, route and final dispatch; an expired lazy price revokes all provisional plans, no source renewal
candidate_priority_computation.diagnostics: candidate_assignments counts priced rows; generated_candidate_assignments counts raw rows
candidate_priority_computation.scope: fixed-source order equivalence and conditional CPU evidence are not live callback latency, worst-case bound or mission acceptance

gain_refinement.algorithm: Original frontier geometry and stable sampling order with unknown rectangle-count upper bounds; refine ray gain then reinsert utility bound before original budget price
gain_refinement.types: Private ViewpointGainBound/AssignmentGainBound, fully resolved normal Viewpoint/Assignment before actual goal or charging forecast
gain_refinement.cache: One immutable source identity for geometry; replacement and mutable aliases cannot reuse it. Exact ray gains belong to one admission/charging context only
gain_refinement.lookahead: Complete original raw alternative pool; same exact stable order and top3 qualifying alternative rules via lazy gain resolution, never use rectangle gain in energy forecast
gain_refinement.proof: Bounds only rank computation. Executed gain/utility/relative/diversity, complete body/return budgets, true current epochs and original2/5s leases are rechecked

known_space.algorithm: Rectangle current-interest bound then exact original visibility/16yaw before existing stable budget heap
known_space.cache: Same immutable admission map and delivered-history interest only; ordinary Viewpoint/Assignment before prices/commands/forecast
known_space.fallback: Resolve enough candidates to establish actual positive visibility; if none, preserve original mapping fallback
known_space.limits: Fixed-source equivalence; no original timing or mission causal claim

route_precheck.algorithm: Necessary useful-prefix bound before exact gains/prices only when actual/provisional reservations exist; original final greedy order and all hard guards retained
route_precheck.proof: Any additional reservation can only move the first conflict earlier; retain every possible useful0.75m prefix even if current final endpoint is stationary. A common initial escape-cell conflict rejects all candidate routes for that robot in this same frozen batch
route_precheck.cache: Body-masked field and geometric proposals only inside one immutable admission snapshot; at most2048 exact Boolean line-of-sight results per field. No source/header/energy decision cache
route_precheck.charging: No speculative route precheck without reservations; existing lower-unfunded alternatives skip full planning and original best-intent serial fairness remains
route_precheck.actual: Original body/accepted reservation/full approach and qualified return/2-5s source checks and dispatch renewal prohibition remain; private bounds never become commands
route_precheck.limits: Conditional fixed-source equivalence and CPU samples, not complete-history replay, causal mission effect or worst-case clock bound

battery_bound.algorithm: Same original model and original source epochs: straight contact-disc distances lower-bound both complete task+return and current return reserve, hence upper-bound actual battery factor. Private ranking only, never a route or admission budget
battery_bound.guards: Every real choice still needs original complete qualified known-map contact paths, actual body route distance, reserve/age/energy/charging fairness; recheck original lease immediately after each expensive price
battery_bound.charging: Within each original refinement pass, only if every raw option is proven unfunded: after the exact highest feasible charge intent is found, lower options may skip price. A possible funded alternative or later refinement pass remains independently evaluated
battery_bound.limits: Fixed-source commands/charge intent equivalence and CPU samples; no task causal gain, original-history replay, live clock bound or Euclidean safety fallback

peer_travel_bound.algorithm: ordered local funded-peer proof before original exact gain and complete actual budget; only a guaranteed-funded subset tightens the original relative-travel factor upper bound
peer_travel_bound.proof: one complete qualified local path at original maximum legal map5s/pose2s ages upper-bounds the min-qualified-route energy; unknown/missing/unfunded proof keeps original neutral bound
peer_travel_bound.scope: ranking only; preserve complete original candidate pool, stable greedy ties, whole body/return budgets, charging fairness, source epochs and all dispatch gates
peer_travel_bound.limits: Fixed-epoch equivalent choices/CPU comparisons only; no original-history, causal mission gain or worst-case completion guarantee

native_contact_arrival.algorithm: Finish the already accepted budgeted contact waypoint before entering CHARGING; crossing the original outer radius does not cancel a pending/owned leg
native_contact_arrival.safety: Original return deadline, progress watchdog, energy/reserve failure, cancel ownership, native Nav2 collision avoidance and charging radius/stopped stable duration remain; no new leg, no obstacle clearing or pose/source renewal
native_contact_arrival.scope: Departure-map occupancy may still invalidate later exploration; this candidate does not claim to solve localization/dynamic SLAM artifacts or guarantee known-free parking after Nav2 goal tolerance

nav2_staging_readiness.scope: Private simulation-only preparation readiness; does not modify task policy, native safety, AP observations or radio traffic.
requirements: all original stage poses in actual costmap bounds
two distinct consecutive fresh delivered ACTIVE states separated by original0.5s heartbeat; duplicate sources do not count
nav2_staging_readiness.evidence: nav2_readiness.jsonl before every original gateway staging leg; unchanged base checks own received map, pose/TF/battery leases and known-free prefix
nav2_staging_readiness.original_stimulus: 50s preparation deadline / 60..250s blackout / 62..248s native motion verification / no abort retry are unchanged
nav2_staging_readiness.state_source: only existing /gateway/received/{robot}/battery_state; original5s source TTL; no native audit/hidden control input

navigation_input_capture.scope: Evaluator-only lossless original CDR; no publishers, no AP or native control input. Diagnostic sampling does not replace exact battery budget snapshots.
navigation_input_capture.topics: Native local map, delivered fused map, global/local Nav2 costmaps and updates, scan, odom, dynamic/static TF and Nav2 plan per robot; AP fused map.
navigation_input_capture.encoding: gzip JSONL with exact received CDR base64, original message type, receipt sim and wall times; original message headers are never rewritten.

rally_proposal_handoff.algorithm: Retain a complete assignment as geometric intent when serial computation outlives its source leases; consume queued original-source updates before admission.
rally_proposal_handoff.revalidation: Same target and required robots; current delivered planning map known-free0.45m endpoints, known target LOS, original camera range, original0.8m separation and target-facing yaw; recalculate original dispatch order.
rally_proposal_handoff.authority: No old battery prices, routes, received pose or source stamps reused. Original fresh complete approach/contact return/serial wait/hold/body guards remain in RALLY preflight and every actual goal.
rally_proposal_handoff.witness: Original exact assignment search epoch plus independent current delivered geometry/source/order admission witness on the existing private audit path; no new application flow.
rally_proposal_handoff.scope: Prevents repeated search starvation; no global optimality, task completion or worst-case callback guarantee from components alone.

native_scan_self_filter.algorithm: Native SLAM input-only strict body interior rejection plus adjacent boundary-range noise association requiring at least one strict-interior seed and three matched rays through a contiguous band. NaNs are skipped, never traced as free rays. Original raw scan/CDR/Nav2, map occupancy rules, headers, energy, full return and TTL guards remain.
native_scan_self_filter.body_geometry: Exact original SDF/URDF chassis interior intersection; unchanged rectangle. Optional calibrated range-noise association declared separately.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Keep the frozen staging stimulus, waiting for a real Nav2 map first."""
import argparse
from collections import deque
import hashlib
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path

from nav_msgs.msg import OccupancyGrid
import rclpy.action
from rclpy.action import ActionClient
from rclpy.qos import DurabilityPolicy,QoSProfile,ReliabilityPolicy
from std_msgs.msg import String

import stage_p3b5_return_probe as original


def nav2_map_ready(grid, positions, now):
    if grid is None or grid.header.frame_id != "map":
        return False
    stamp=grid.header.stamp.sec+grid.header.stamp.nanosec*1e-9
    info=grid.info
    orientation=info.origin.orientation
    values=(now,stamp,info.resolution,info.origin.position.x,info.origin.position.y,
            orientation.x,orientation.y,orientation.z,orientation.w)
    if (not all(math.isfinite(v) for v in values) or not 0<=now-stamp<=2.
            or info.resolution<=0 or info.width<=0 or info.height<=0
            or len(grid.data)!=info.width*info.height
            or any(abs(v)>1e-6 for v in (orientation.x,orientation.y,orientation.z))
            or abs(abs(orientation.w)-1.)>1e-6):
        return False
    for x,y in positions:
        column=math.floor((x-info.origin.position.x)/info.resolution)
        row=math.floor((y-info.origin.position.y)/info.resolution)
        if not (0<=row<info.height and 0<=column<info.width):
            return False
    return True


def delivered_active_stable(records,now):
    """Two distinct delivered heartbeat sources; no native hidden state."""
    if len(records)!=2 or not math.isfinite(now):return False
    stamps=[row['stamp_sec'] for row in records]
    return (all(row['mode']=='ACTIVE' for row in records)
        and all(math.isfinite(stamp) and 0<=now-stamp<5. for stamp in stamps)
        and stamps[1]-stamps[0]>=.5-1e-9)


def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(add_help=False)
    parser.add_argument("--config",type=Path,required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output",type=Path,required=True)
    arguments,_=parser.parse_known_args()
    config=json.loads(arguments.config.read_text())
    assert hashlib.sha256(Path(original.__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==config["staging_base_content_sha256"]
    positions=[pose[:2] for pose in config["return_staging"]["poses"].values()]
    evidence=arguments.output.with_name("nav2_readiness.jsonl")
    assert not evidence.exists()

    class ReadyStagingClient(ActionClient):
        def __init__(self,node,action_type,action_name):
            super().__init__(node,action_type,action_name)
            self.task_node=node
            self.robot=action_name.split("/")[2]
            self.grid=None
            self.last_ready=None
            self.batteries=deque(maxlen=2)
            self.map_subscription=node.create_subscription(OccupancyGrid,
                f"/{self.robot}/global_costmap/costmap",lambda message:setattr(self,"grid",message),1)
            qos=QoSProfile(depth=1,reliability=ReliabilityPolicy.RELIABLE,
                           durability=DurabilityPolicy.TRANSIENT_LOCAL)
            self.battery_subscription=node.create_subscription(String,
                f"/gateway/received/{self.robot}/battery_state",self.battery_received,qos)

        def battery_received(self,message):
            state=json.loads(message.data)
            row=dict(mode=state['mode'],stamp_sec=state['stamp_sec'])
            if row['mode']!='ACTIVE' or not math.isfinite(row['stamp_sec']):
                self.batteries.clear()
            elif not self.batteries or row['stamp_sec']>self.batteries[-1]['stamp_sec']:
                self.batteries.append(row)

        def server_is_ready(self):
            now=self.task_node.get_clock().now().nanoseconds/1e9
            ready=(super().server_is_ready() and nav2_map_ready(self.grid,positions,now)
                   and delivered_active_stable(self.batteries,now))
            if ready or ready!=self.last_ready:
                self.last_ready=ready
                row=dict(event="nav2_staging_readiness",robot=self.robot,observer_time=now,ready=ready,
                         delivered_battery_records=list(self.batteries))
                if self.grid is not None:
                    info=self.grid.info
                    row.update(map_header_time=self.grid.header.stamp.sec+self.grid.header.stamp.nanosec*1e-9,
                        frame=self.grid.header.frame_id,width=info.width,height=info.height,
                        resolution=info.resolution,origin=[info.origin.position.x,info.origin.position.y],
                        data_length=len(self.grid.data),
                        orientation=[info.origin.orientation.x,info.origin.orientation.y,
                                     info.origin.orientation.z,info.origin.orientation.w])
                with evidence.open("a") as output:
                    output.write(json.dumps(row,allow_nan=False)+"\n")
            return ready

    # The frozen fixture imports ActionClient inside main. Scope this adapter
    # to this single-process fixture invocation and restore it on every exit.
    rclpy.action.ActionClient=ReadyStagingClient
    try:
        return original.main()
    finally:
        rclpy.action.ActionClient=ActionClient


if __name__=="__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
